validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (HIGH): P6719 is one line of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3), a real ~$8.8bn LSTK / ~$10bn, 17-EPC-package megaproject adding ~3.15 bscfd and ~4,000-4,153 km of 56-inch east-west gas pipeline, construction commenced Q2 2024, target completion Q4 2028. Independently reported by MEED (verified: page contains 'EWPS-1', 'EWPS-3', '300', '56'), Pipeline Technology Journal (L&T completed a 120km 56-inch MGS Package 8 section, 2025-09-10), BlackRidge Research (Q4 2028 completion), and OGN. The sheet's own cited MEED source explicitly names 'Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-1 to EWPS-3'. CLASSIFICATION (HIGH): correctly recorded as a gas transmission trunk (large-diameter east-west transport line) - not a gathering/process/feeder line. ATTRIBUTION (HIGH): Owner Aramco 100% is correct (MGS is an Aramco system). DUPLICATE CHECK: P6720 (roster: same 150km/56in, EWPS-1->EWPS-3) is the parallel companion line '4' of the same route - two physically distinct parallel pipes (line 3 and line 4), so two rows is a legitimate model, NOT a double-count/duplicate. DIAMETER 56in and StartYear1 2028 (= project in-service target, Q4 2028) both corroborated. See separate validity object for the length concern.

validity.recommendation: Verify per-line length: MEED gives EWPS-1->EWPS-3 as 300km; GEM records 150km per line. If 300km is the route distance both parallel lines span, P6719 and P6720 should each be ~300km, not 150km. Likely a systematic halving error across the whole EWPS pair-cluster (P6717/18, P6721/22, P6723/24, ...) - escalate for a cluster-wide length review.
validity.researcher_notes: LENGTH (MEDIUM, material factor-of-2 discrepancy). The sheet's cited MEED source states: 'Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-1 to EWPS-3, covering 300km.' GEM entered P6719 (line 3) = 150km and P6720 (line 4) = 150km, i.e. it interpreted 300km as the COMBINED pipe for both lines (300/2 = 150 each). But the parallel-package wording ('...from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10, covering a distance of 480km', OGN) and the physical geometry argue the figures are ROUTE distances that BOTH lines span in full: the sibling package EWPS-3->EWPS-4 is a single inter-station gap of 166km (GEM halved it to 83+83 for P6721/P6722) - two parallel pipes each necessarily run the full inter-station gap, so halving a single-gap route across the two lines cannot be physically right. Under the route-distance reading, EWPS-1->EWPS-3 spans two station gaps (~300km) and each of line 3 and line 4 is ~300km, making GEM's 150km an undercount by ~2x. This appears systematic across the entire pair-cluster. I could not locate a source stating the individual line length explicitly, so I flag rather than overwrite; the recommended fix is a cluster-wide length verification. Do NOT silently pass.
